contents.html: The issuance process for a Derived PIV Credential varies depending whether the Derived PIV Credential is issued at LOA-3 or LOA-4. Section 2.2 specifies the requirements for initial issuance. This appendix provides two example issuance processes that satisfy those requirements, one at LOA-3 and another at LOA-4.
contents.html_ja: 派生PIVクレデンシャルの発行プロセスは、派生PIVクレデンシャルをLOA-3で発行するかLOA-4で発行するかによって異なります。2.2節では初回発行の要件を規定します。本付録では、それらの要件を満たす発行プロセスの例を二つ示します。一方はLOA-3、もう一方はLOA-4の場合です。

contents.html: C.1 Example Issuance of Derived PIV Credentials at Level of Identity Assurance 3
contents.html_ja: C.1 ID保証レベル3での派生PIVクレデンシャル発行例

contents.html: An employee requires a mobile device for work. The mobile device is ordered and a request for the issuance of a Derived PIV Credential is submitted to the agency’s approval authority.
contents.html_ja: 従業員は業務用のモバイルデバイスを必要としています。モバイルデバイスが発注され、派生PIVクレデンシャルの発行申請が機関の承認機関に提出されます。

contents.html: Once the employee has received the device and the request has been approved the employee starts the issuance process by visiting a Web site operated by a registration authority (RA) that is associated with the certification authority (CA) that will issue the Derived PIV Credential. The Web site requires TLS client authentication using the PIV Authentication certificate on the employee’s PIV Card. Since the employee cannot use the PIV Card with the mobile device the employee performs this step from a desktop computer. By requiring the use of the PIV Authentication certificate when connecting to the Web site and by validating the certificate, the server not only authenticates the employee, but also verifies that the employee is still eligible to possess a PIV credential. If the employee successfully authenticates to the server then the RA issues the employee a one-time password (OTP).
contents.html_ja: 従業員がデバイスを受け取り、申請が承認されると、従業員は派生PIVクレデンシャルを発行する認証局（CA）と連携する登録機関（RA）が運用するWebサイトにアクセスして発行プロセスを開始します。このWebサイトでは、従業員のPIVカード上のPIV認証証明書を使ったTLSクライアント認証が必要となります。従業員はモバイルデバイスでPIVカードを使用できないため、この手順をデスクトップコンピューターで行います。Webサイトへの接続時にPIV認証証明書の使用を求め、証明書を検証することで、サーバーは従業員を認証するだけでなく、その従業員が引き続きPIVクレデンシャルを所持する資格があることも確認します。従業員がサーバーに正常に認証されると、RAは従業員にワンタイムパスワード（OTP）を発行します。

contents.html: The employee then runs a provisioning application on the mobile device. The application asks the employee to enter the OTP that was previously provided and to create a password, which will subsequently be used to authenticate to the cryptographic module. The application generates a key pair within the device’s cryptographic module and submits the OTP and newly generated public key to the RA as part of a certificate request. The RA authenticates the employee by verifying that the OTP in the certificate request matches the one that it previously issued, signs the certificate request, and forwards it to the CA, which issues the Derived PIV Credential (i.e., the Derived PIV Authentication certificate). The provisioning application loads the Derived PIV Authentication certificate on the mobile device.
contents.html_ja: 次に従業員はモバイルデバイス上でプロビジョニングアプリケーションを実行します。アプリケーションは、先ほど受け取ったOTPの入力と、その後に暗号モジュールの認証に使用するパスワードの作成を求めます。アプリケーションはデバイスの暗号モジュール内で鍵ペアを生成し、証明書要求の一部としてOTPと新たに生成した公開鍵をRAに送信します。RAは、証明書要求内のOTPが先に発行したものと一致することを検証して従業員を認証し、証明書要求に署名してCAに転送します。CAは派生PIVクレデンシャル（すなわち派生PIV認証証明書）を発行します。プロビジョニングアプリケーションは、派生PIV認証証明書をモバイルデバイスに読み込みます。

contents.html: C.2 Example Issuance of Derived PIV Credentials at Level of Identity Assurance 4
contents.html_ja: C.2 ID保証レベル4での派生PIVクレデンシャル発行例

contents.html: An employee requests a mobile device and Derived PIV Credential for work. The request is approved by the agency’s approval authority.
contents.html_ja: 従業員は業務用にモバイルデバイスと派生PIVクレデンシャルを申請します。申請は機関の承認機関によって承認されます。

contents.html: The IT department sets up an appointment for Derived PIV Credential issuance and device pickup. At the appointment, the IT staff directs the employee to an issuance station where the employee is asked to insert the PIV Card into the issuance workstation and provide the password and a fingerprint. The issuance station performs the PKI-AUTH and BIO authentication mechanisms from Section 6.2 of [FIPS201].
contents.html_ja: IT部門は、派生PIV認証情報の発行とデバイス受け取りの予約を設定します。予約時にIT担当者は従業員を発行ステーションに案内し、PIVカードを発行ワークステーションに挿入してパスワードと指紋を提示するよう求めます。発行ステーションは、[FIPS201]の6.2節に記載されたPKI-AUTHおよびBIO認証メカニズムを実行します。

contents.html: An IT staff member assigns a USB token to the employee and inserts it into the USB port of the issuance station. The issuance station generates the Derived PIV Credential’s key pair on the USB token, creates a certificate request that includes the newly generated public key, and forwards the request to the CA, which issues the Derived PIV Credential (i.e., the Derived PIV Authentication certificate). The employee is asked to set the password to activate the cryptographic module on the USB token. As a last step, the issuance station loads the Derived PIV Authentication certificate on the USB token.
contents.html_ja: IT担当者が従業員にUSBトークンを割り当て、発行ステーションのUSBポートに挿入します。発行ステーションはUSBトークン上で派生PIVクレデンシャルの鍵ペアを生成し、新しく生成された公開鍵を含む証明書要求を作成してCAに転送します。CAは派生PIVクレデンシャル（すなわち派生PIV認証証明書）を発行します。従業員はUSBトークン上の暗号モジュールを有効化するパスワードを設定するよう求められます。最後に、発行ステーションが派生PIV認証証明書をUSBトークンに読み込みます。

contents.html: Increasingly, mobile devices are becoming thinner and/or lighter. These constraints limit external ports and force the integration of authentication tokens and security features. As indicated by column 6 in Table D-1,15 four of the five tokens with Derived PIV Credentials are integrated. For these tokens, guidance will be made available by OMB to provide an alternative to the remote authentication policy in M-06-16 and M-07-16. With integrated tokens, authentication factors are not provided by a separate token and sensitive government information may be at greater risk of loss. OMB’s alternative guidance intends to also address these risks by pointing to NIST guidelines for compensating controls (e.g., SP 800-53, SP 800-124, SP 800-164).

contents.html: Selected terms used in the guide are defined below.
contents.html_ja: 本ガイドで使用する主な用語を以下に定義します。

contents.html: Applicant: An individual who has applied for, but has not yet been issued, a Derived PIV Credential.
contents.html_ja: 申請者：派生PIVクレデンシャルを申請したが、まだ発行を受けていない個人。

contents.html: Application Protocol Data Unit: A part of the application layer in the Open Systems Interconnection Reference model that is used for communication between two separate device's applications. In the context of smart cards, an APDU is the communication unit between a smart card reader and a smart card. The structure of the APDU is defined by [ISO7816-4].
contents.html_ja: アプリケーションプロトコルデータユニット：2つの別個のデバイスのアプリケーション間の通信に使用される、開放型システム間相互接続（OSI）参照モデルのアプリケーション層の一部。スマートカードの文脈では、APDUはスマートカードリーダーとスマートカード間の通信単位です。APDUの構造は[ISO7816-4]で定義されます。

contents.html: Derived PIV Application: A standardized application residing on a removable, hardware cryptographic token that hosts a Derived PIV Credential and associated mandatory and optional elements.
contents.html_ja: 派生PIVアプリケーション：派生PIVクレデンシャルと、関連する必須要素および任意要素をホストする、取り外し可能なハードウェア暗号トークン上に存在する標準化アプリケーション。

contents.html: Derived PIV Credential: An X.509 Derived PIV Authentication certificate, which is issued in accordance with the requirements specified in this document where the PIV Authentication certificate on the Applicant’s PIV Card serves as the original credential. The Derived PIV Credential is an additional common identity credential under HSPD-12 and FIPS 201 that is issued by a Federal department or agency and that is used with mobile devices.
contents.html_ja: 派生PIVクレデンシャル：申請者のPIVカード上のPIV認証証明書を元のクレデンシャルとして、本書の要件に従って発行されるX.509派生PIV認証証明書。派生PIVクレデンシャルは、HSPD-12およびFIPS 201に基づく追加の共通IDクレデンシャルであり、連邦省庁・機関が発行し、モバイルデバイスで使用します。

contents.html: Mobile Device: A portable computing device that: (i) has a small form factor such that it can easily be carried by a single individual; (ii) is designed to operate without a physical connection (e.g., wirelessly transmit or receive information); (iii) possesses local, non-removable or removable data storage; and (iv) includes a self-contained power source. Mobile devices may also include voice communication capabilities, on-board sensors that allow the devices to capture information, and/or built-in features for synchronizing local data with remote locations. Examples include smart phones, tablets, and e-readers.
contents.html_ja: モバイルデバイス：次の性質を持つ携帯型コンピューティングデバイス。(i) 一人で容易に持ち運べる小型フォームファクターを持ちます。(ii) 物理接続なしに動作するよう設計されています（例：無線で情報を送受信します）。(iii) ローカルの、取り外し不可または取り外し可能なデータストレージを備えます。(iv) 自給式電源を備えます。モバイルデバイスには、音声通信機能、情報を取得するオンボードセンサー、および／またはローカルデータを遠隔地と同期する組み込み機能が含まれる場合もあります。例としてスマートフォン、タブレット、電子書籍リーダーがあります。

contents.html: Subscriber: The individual who is the subject named or identified in a Derived PIV Authentication certificate and who holds the token that contains the private key that corresponds to the public key in the certificate.
contents.html_ja: 加入者：派生PIV認証証明書で名前が記載または識別され、その証明書内の公開鍵に対応する秘密鍵を格納したトークンを保有する個人。

original_blocks.html: The UICC includes storage and processing, as well as input/output capabilities. Unlike the SIM card, the UICC can also support a variety of other applications and services and multiple security domains.10 [GP-A] defines a mechanism for an application provider to manage (i.e., load, install and personalize) its application in a confidential manner while using a third party communication network. The Derived PIV Application shall be installed in a security domain that is separate from other security domains, dedicated to the Derived PIV Credential, and under the explicit control of the issuing agency. The APDUs as specified in Appendix B shall be used with this secure element containing the PIV Derived Application.11

10 A security domain is a protected area on a UICC. To this security domain are assigned applications, which can use cryptographic services it offers. By default only the security domain of the card issuer exists on a card. If another institution
original_blocks.html_ja: 10 セキュリティドメインはUICC上の保護領域である。このセキュリティドメインにはアプリケーションが割り当てられ、そのアプリケーションは当該ドメインが提供する暗号サービスを利用できる。既定では、カード上に存在するのはカード発行者のセキュリティドメインのみである。別の機関が

A UICC is a secure element, which may be capable of hosting a Derived PIV Application. A UICC used to host a Derived PIV Credential shall implement the GlobalPlatform Card Secure Element Configuration v1.0 [GP-SE].

Note: Many mobile devices on the market provide a hybrid approach where the key is stored in hardware, but a software cryptographic module uses the key during an authentication operation. original_blocks.html_ja: 2. ライフサイクル活動と関連要件

original_blocks.html: The lifecycle activities (phases) for a Derived PIV Credential are initial issuance and maintenance. This section describes these lifecycle activities and provides requirements and recommendations as appropriate.
original_blocks.html_ja: 派生PIV認証情報のライフサイクル活動（段階）は、初回発行と保守である。本節では、これらのライフサイクル活動を説明し、該当する要件および推奨事項を示す。

original_blocks.html: Issuers of Derived PIV Credentials must document the process for each of the lifecycle activities described below. In accordance with [HSPD-12], the reliability of the Derived PIV Credential issuer shall be established through an official accreditation process. The process, as outlined in [SP800-79], shall include an independent (third-party) assessment.
